notes: Static feed covers municipal buses (SPPO), executive buses and BRT. MetrôRio, SuperVia, VLT Carioca and CCR Barcas publish no GTFS: no rail/ferry timetable here (research §1.3).
Real-time trip ids match the static feed for only ~40 % of buses: matched by route + direction + time.
Rio encodes holidays in calendar_dates until 2027-11; the Pathfinder holiday table only fills dates the feed leaves out.
